comingLast.roast: finished with 25 - the blue balls are one countback from home
the rescue mission: 10 points, 3 holes, no pressure at all
escape number: 9. holes remaining: 4. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
needs 6 from 3 - his playing group has started the commentary
on 15 - the two blue balls have begun their lap of honour early
4 to play and the blue balls are already doing warm-down stretches
at 1.4 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
at 1.4 a hole the blue balls fit like they were measured for him
